parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Umuokom (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 156.2 | 0.60549 | 0.60549
2 | 421.4 | 0.33169 | 0.93718
3 | 2559.4 | 4.3105 | 5.2477
4 | 1032 | 30.476 | 35.724
5 | 75.659 | 10.418 | 36.766
6 | 1081.5 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Umuokom
Curve type: H-type
Aquifer depth: 5.2 - 35.7 m
Recommendation: Target the fractured zone between 5.2m and 35.7m depth. Ensure adequate well screen placement within this interval to maximize water yield.
